summary: Shadow deliverable for audit replication: per-record HMAC and resumable delivery tokens for EU SIEM handoff
description: Issue summary: Customer requests a 'shadow' replication stream of production audit events to their SIEM in eu-west. They require per-record HMAC verification, resumable delivery (resume tokens), and deterministic ordering metadata so their forensic tooling can attest chain-of-custody. Impact: NordicBank depends on this feed for regulatory reporting; delays or mismatches block their weekly audit reconciliation and compliance attestation. Environment: Redwood prod audit-exporter -> S3 handoff (eu-west), KMS for envelope keys, customer pulls via transfer job. Desired outcome: Provide a delivery mechanism that includes (1) per-record HMAC (customer-provided key or Redwood-rotating KEK) included as a metadata attribute, (2) resumable delivery tokens/checkpoints in the S3 manifest so they can resume from the last acknowledged record without duplication, (3) canonical ordering field and sequence monotonically increasing per-tenant, and (4) audit receipt acknowledgements (optional).
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer configures shadow export in Console with destination S3 bucket in eu-west and enables 'shadow' option.
2) Trigger a batch of tenant activity that should be exported (login, model-invoke, admin-action).
3) Customer's transfer job attempts to pull new objects and validate per-record HMAC against expected key.
4) Transfer job fails to resume cleanly after a partial download; duplicate records appear or resume token missing from manifest.

investigation_notes: 2026-03-10 10:00 UTC - Triage: Reproduced resume_token missing in manifest: the exporter writes a per-batch manifest but the resume_token is only present in full manifest when batch closes. Hypothesis: partial upload window leads to manifest with empty resume field.
2026-03-11 09:20 UTC - Checked KMS logs: envelope generation successful for batch keys; no KMS errors. Related GitHub PR for manifest schema change found: #1423.

2026-03-12 14:45 UTC - Load on exporter node high at time of partial uploads; suspect race where manifest is circulated before atomic metadata write completes. Traced to exporter flush path (audit-exporter v3.7.1).

2026-03-12 17:30 UTC - Temporary mitigation applied: exporter now writes a 'manifest.partial' and atomically renames to 'manifest.json' after resume_token set. Observed transfer worker resume success in canary tenant nb-999.

2026-03-11 09:30 UTC - Infra (M. Silva): Reproduced missing resume_token on partial uploads. Root cause candidate: non-atomic metadata write on exporter flush. Filed PR to change write path (see related PR).

resolution: Workaround: Enabled atomic manifest rename flow and provided customer with verification script (attached) and expected manifest schema. Customer can re-run nightly transfer; duplicates mitigated. Long-term fix: landed PR to add per-record HMAC header (HMAC-SHA256) using a rotating KEK stored in KMS and explicit resume_token index in each manifest object. Rollout plan: QA -> staged rollout (20% tenants) -> full prod (target 2026-03-20). Follow-ups: add e2e test for partial upload/resume, add docs section to Console UI for configuring HMAC key rotation and verification sample code.
